name: copilotkit
summary: I successfully completed all the setup steps from the CopilotKit quickstart: created the Next.js app (`npx create-next-app@latest` succeeded), installed all three CopilotKit packages (`npm install @copilotkit/react-core @copilotkit/react-ui @copilotkit/runtime` added 1,215 packages), created the `.env` file, wrote the `app/api/copilotkit/route.ts` runtime endpoint, updated `app/layout.tsx` with the `CopilotKit` provider, and updated `app/page.tsx` with the `CopilotSidebar` component. I then started `npm run build`, which launched the Next.js 16.3.1 Turbopack build process and began creating the optimized production build (the `.next/build/chunks/` directory was populated and the `next-build` process was actively running at 30.6% CPU). However, the build did not finish within the available time/budget — it was still compiling when the run ended, so I could not verify that the app serves successfully or that the copilot endpoint responds.
